answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the jetty queue naming the hollow that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 7 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Thus, every sock puppet costs 7 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the quartz record shows exactly who is still on probation. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
